subject: Intro — Redwood initial demo: timing, attendees, and evidence requests
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@cervexa.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@cervexa.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — Redwood initial demo: timing, attendees, and evidence requests

Hi Emily / Carlos,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday, Emily — excited to get a short discovery + product walkthrough scheduled so we can:
- confirm your primary goals for proof-of-concept (latency, throughput, data retention constraints)
- validate integration surface (S3 / API / VPC choices)
- surface any procurement/compliance needs early so timelines stay realistic

Would a 45-minute slot work for a focused session? Proposed windows next week (all ET/PDT provided if helpful):
- Tue 9/14 — 10:00–10:45 PT / 13:00–13:45 ET
- Wed 9/15 — 09:00–09:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET
- Thu 9/16 — 14:00–14:45 PT / 17:00–17:45 ET

Attendees from our side: myself (AE), Soojin (SE — will cover security/integration), and Dylan (solutions PM — short product roadmap context). Can you confirm the right engineering contact and the procurement/finance reviewer we should loop in?

I attached a short pre-demo checklist to help align expectations. If any of the slots above are hard, tell us two alternatives and we’ll flex.

Thanks — looking forward to it,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Carlos / Ana,

Great — let’s lock Wed 9/15 12:00–12:45 ET (we’ll send an invite for that slot).
Quick notes for the agenda (45m):
- 5m intros and success criteria (Emily / Carlos)
- 20m product demo: live inference walk-through, latency/cost tradeoffs (Marissa + Dylan)
- 10m integration security: data flow, encryption, SOC2 & audit logs (Soojín)
- 10m Q&A + next steps (procurement timeline / pilot scope)

Soojín — can you attach the SOC2 summary and the short network/data-flow diagram for Ana to review?

Carlos — if you can send any specific PII/data-handling constraints you need covered we’ll add to the agenda.

I’ll include a one-line agenda in the invite and a calendar .ics.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro — Redwood initial demo: timing, attendees, and evidence requests

Thanks — attaching the SOC2 summary and a high-level network diagram (stubs below). A couple quick prep items from the SE side so we’re efficient in the 45m:
- Please confirm whether you want us to demo with a staging dataset or live API access. If staging, provide a sample S3 path and a small test file (PII redacted).
- If you plan to discuss private deployment (VPC/on-prem), tell us whether you want to include your cloud infra lead.
- Ana / procurement: SOC2-summary.pdf and the network-diagram.png are attached; let me know if you need a signed attestation or vendor questionnaire responses (we can provide both).

Internal note to Marissa / Dylan: we should reserve 10m to show KV cache behavior and how prefix caching reduces per-token cost for short-turn workloads — that typically answers concerns from infra teams.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF), network-diagram.png (image)

—
Soojín Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0187
